title: Sum of Array Elements
description:
Store the numbers in an array and print their sum.
Hint: start a `sum` variable at 0 and add each element in a loop.
Input: the first line contains `n`, the number of elements; the second line contains `n` integers separated by spaces.
Output: a single integer, the sum.

title: Largest Element in Array
description:
Find and print the largest element of the array.
Hint: assume `a[0]` is the largest, then compare with every other element.
Input: the first line contains `n`, the number of elements; the second line contains `n` integers separated by spaces.
Output: a single integer.

title: Smallest Element in Array
description:
Find and print the smallest element of the array.
Hint: assume `a[0]` is the smallest, then compare with every other element.
Input: the first line contains `n`, the number of elements; the second line contains `n` integers separated by spaces.
Output: a single integer.

title: Count Even and Odd Numbers
description:
Count how many elements are even and how many are odd. Zero is even.
Hint: use `x % 2 == 0` (careful: for negative odd numbers `x % 2` is -1, so test `== 0`).
Input: the first line contains `n`, the number of elements; the second line contains `n` integers separated by spaces.
Output: two lines: `Even: E` and `Odd: O`.

title: Reverse an Array
description:
Print the array elements in reverse order.
Hint: loop from index `n-1` down to 0.
Input: the first line contains `n`, the number of elements; the second line contains `n` integers separated by spaces.
Output: the elements on one line separated by single spaces, with no trailing space.

title: Linear Search
description:
Given an array and a target value `x`, print the 0-based index of the first occurrence of `x`, or `-1` if it is not present.
Hint: loop through the array and stop (`break`) when found.
Input: the first line contains `n`; the second line contains `n` integers; the third line contains `x`.
Output: a single integer.

title: Count Occurrences of a Number
description:
Count how many times a value `x` appears in the array.
Hint: increase a counter each time `a[i] == x`.
Input: the first line contains `n`; the second line contains `n` integers; the third line contains `x`.
Output: a single integer (0 if absent).

title: Check if Array is Sorted
description:
Check whether the array is sorted in non-decreasing order (each element is >= the one before it).
Hint: if you find any `a[i] < a[i-1]`, it is not sorted.
Input: the first line contains `n`, the number of elements; the second line contains `n` integers separated by spaces.
Output: `Yes` if sorted, otherwise `No`.

title: Sum of Elements at Even Indices
description:
Print the sum of the elements located at indices 0, 2, 4, ... (0-based).
Hint: start the loop at 0 and step by 2.
Input: the first line contains `n`, the number of elements; the second line contains `n` integers separated by spaces.
Output: a single integer.

title: Count Positives, Negatives and Zeros
description:
Count how many elements are positive, negative and zero.
Hint: use an if / else if / else chain inside a loop.
Input: the first line contains `n`, the number of elements; the second line contains `n` integers separated by spaces.
Output: three lines: `Positive: P`, `Negative: N`, `Zero: Z`.

title: Second Largest Element
description:
Print the second largest distinct value in the array. It is guaranteed that the array has at least two different values.
Hint: track `first` and `second`; update them as you scan. Equal values to the largest must not become the second largest.
Input: the first line contains `n`, the number of elements; the second line contains `n` integers separated by spaces.
Output: a single integer.
constraints: 2 <= n; at least two distinct values exist

title: Remove Duplicates
description:
Print the array keeping only the first occurrence of each value, preserving the original order.
Hint: for each element, check whether it already appeared earlier in the array.
Input: the first line contains `n`, the number of elements; the second line contains `n` integers separated by spaces.
Output: the elements on one line separated by single spaces, with no trailing space.

title: Frequency of Each Digit
description:
The array contains digits between 0 and 9. Print how many times each digit that appears occurs, in increasing digit order.
Hint: use a counting array `cnt[10]` and do `cnt[a[i]]++`.
Input: the first line contains `n`; the second line contains `n` digits (0-9).
Output: one line `d: c` for every digit `d` that appears at least once, in increasing order of `d`.

title: Rotate Array Left
description:
Rotate the array to the left by `k` positions and print it. Elements that fall off the front wrap around to the end. For example, rotating `1 2 3 4 5` by 2 gives `3 4 5 1 2`.
Hint: the new element at index `i` is `a[(i + k) % n]`.
Input: the first line contains `n` and `k`; the second line contains `n` integers.
Output: the elements on one line separated by single spaces, with no trailing space.

title: Merge Two Sorted Arrays
description:
Two arrays are each sorted in non-decreasing order. Merge them into one sorted array and print it.
Hint: keep one index per array and always take the smaller current element.
Input: line 1 contains `n` and `m`; line 2 contains `n` integers; line 3 contains `m` integers.
Output: the elements on one line separated by single spaces, with no trailing space.

title: Prefix Sum Array
description:
Print the prefix sums of the array: element `i` of the output is the sum of the input elements from index 0 to `i`. For `1 2 3 4` the output is `1 3 6 10`.
Hint: `r[i] = r[i-1] + a[i]`.
Input: the first line contains `n`, the number of elements; the second line contains `n` integers separated by spaces.
Output: the elements on one line separated by single spaces, with no trailing space.

title: Sort Array in Ascending Order
description:
Sort the array in ascending order using a simple method such as bubble sort, then print it.
Hint: repeatedly compare neighbours and swap them if they are in the wrong order.
Input: the first line contains `n`, the number of elements; the second line contains `n` integers separated by spaces.
Output: the elements on one line separated by single spaces, with no trailing space.

title: Maximum Subarray Sum
description:
Find the largest possible sum of a non-empty contiguous part (subarray) of the array. For `-2 1 -3 4 -1 2 1 -5 4` the answer is 6 (from `4 -1 2 1`).
Hint: at each position, either extend the current run (`cur + a[i]`) or start fresh at `a[i]`; remember the best seen (Kadane's idea).
Input: the first line contains `n`, the number of elements; the second line contains `n` integers separated by spaces.
Output: a single integer.

title: Count Pairs with Given Sum
description:
Count the pairs of positions `(i, j)` with `i < j` such that `a[i] + a[j]` equals a target `k`. Equal values at different positions count as different pairs.
Hint: use two nested loops where `j` starts at `i + 1`.
Input: the first line contains `n` and `k`; the second line contains `n` integers.
Output: a single integer.

title: Longest Run of Consecutive Values
description:
Find the length of the longest group of values that form consecutive integers when sorted, ignoring order and duplicates. For `100 4 200 1 3 2` the values 1, 2, 3, 4 are consecutive, so the answer is 4.
Hint: mark every value in a boolean array indexed by `value + 1000`, then scan it for the longest streak of marked cells.
Input: the first line contains `n`, the number of elements; the second line contains `n` integers separated by spaces.
Output: a single integer.
